one_line: Finished book first, then a screen recording of the order steps, closed by one open topic question.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a blurred hand over a sofa; 0:01 a hardcover with a first-birthday cake lies on the sofa; 0:02 a hand lifts it. Voice and subtitles start together (transcript): "מכירים את זה שבא לכם להשקיע במתנה, אבל לא סתם מתנה."
q1_hook.why: "מכירים את זה" sorts out gift shoppers in one line (H1), and the finished book is on screen at 0:01, before any explanation (H2). Voice and big subtitles open together (H6, T3). The very first frame is a blur, a weak cover frame (H7).

beats.what: Blur, then the finished book on a sofa, lifted to show the cover; "אבל לא סתם מתנה,"
beats.why: Result and gift need arrive together

beats.what: Monitor with a Google search, then close on the site; "שחיפשתי והגעתי"
beats.why: A short how-I-found-it step makes the story believable

beats.what: Phone screen recording: site home page, photo upload dialog with tips, mascot loading screen
Adventure choice list and grid, then a cover preview and story text in the editor
beats.why: New screen every 1 to 2 s keeps the eye moving

beats.what: Edit-title dialog, then the dedication box; subtitles run over the keyboard
beats.why: Personalising steps make the book feel one of a kind

beats.what: Dissolve back to the sofa: book opened, the cover top-down; "הספר הגיע אליי", "משבוע"
beats.why: Delivery speed answers a buyer's doubt

beats.what: Inner page with the logo and six story covers; "אז מה נושא הספר" ... "להזמין?"
beats.why: Ends on a choice the viewer can answer

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: A spoken and subtitled question at 0:28 to 0:30: "אז מה נושא הספר שאתם הייתם בוחרים להזמין?" (transcript) over six alternative covers. The caption asks nothing.
q2_flow.why: Find, make, receive, ask is a clear arc, and the screen changes every 1 to 3 s, so there is little dead air (R1, R3, K2). The finished book at the start and back at the end frames the process (R4). The closing frame shows the options, which makes the question easy to answer (R6).

q3_cta.what: Spoken (transcript) and subtitled at 0:28 to 0:30: "אז מה נושא הספר שאתם הייתם בוחרים להזמין?". No link, code or price. Caption: "המתנה המושלמת לקטנטנים" with the brand tag, no ask.
q3_cta.why: One open question, said and shown together, after the product and process (C1, C5, C6). It is a concrete choice a parent can answer (R6). But the subtitle sits in the bottom 35%, and a ready buyer gets no link, code or next step (C6).

q4_shown.what: The finished book with a first-birthday cake and the child's name on the cover, 0:01 and 0:25-0:28; the site on a monitor; phone screen recording 0:07-0:22 of upload, adventure, editor, title, dedication; the opened book; six other covers. No price, no photo beside a page.
q4_shown.why: The screen recording shows the personalising act, upload to dedication, which a parent can picture (S8). The name on the cover is visible for seconds, but no photo of the child sits beside the illustration (S2). One first-hand line, "הגיע לי תוך פחות משבוע" (transcript), is the only vouch (S6). No child on camera (S5).

q5_edit.what: 23 detected shots in 30 s (about 1.3 s), many are page changes inside the screen recording. Four blocks: sofa, monitor, phone recording, sofa. A dissolve at 0:22. Subtitles of 1 to 3 words change about every 1 s. Ends on the question frame.
q5_edit.why: Fast changes suit a how-to, and screen steps are new information each time (E2, R3). Word-by-word subtitles are synced to the voice (E4). Over the recording they hide the fields and buttons being shown (T2). No dead tail after the question (E8).

q6_topic.what: How a parent ordered a personalised first-birthday style gift book online, step by step, and got it in under a week. It serves a gift buyer asking how it works.
q6_topic.why: A gift moment with a clear buyer (the viewer shopping for a baby) is a buying moment (K7), and a gift idea is easy to send on (R5). The steps and delivery time are practical facts inside a short personal story (K4). The feeling stays calm, not a peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld top-down and high-angle shots on a beige sofa and blanket in daylight; a static shot of a monitor; a phone screen recording over a blurred desk; a woman from the neck down holding the book. Hands only, no face, no child.
q7_filmed.why: A home sofa and a real hand read as a creator, not an ad (H8, F7). The top-down cover is large and readable (F4, F5), and hands-only needs no face (S4).

q8_text.on_screen: Word-by-word white bold subtitles, 1 to 3 words, large, centred about 75% down the frame, also over the screen recording: "מכירים את זה שבא" (0:00), "להשקיע" (0:01), "אבל לא סתם מתנה," (0:02), "אתר שבו אפשר בקלות" (0:07), "הקדשה" (0:22), "הספר הגיע אליי" (0:24), "משבוע" (0:25), "אז מה נושא הספר" (0:28), "להזמין?" (0:29). No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "המתנה המושלמת לקטנטנים" then the @mebook.ai tag on the same line, and two hashtags: #ugc #ugccontentcreator. One line, no question, no ask, no price, no disclosure word.
q8_text.why: Subtitles carry every spoken beat in short chunks, so it works muted (T1, T2), but they sit in the bottom 35% and cover the UI being shown (T4, F2). White text on the white page is hard to read (T5). No parent search words in the caption (T7); the partnership is only a tag (T8).

weak_points: Big subtitles covering the screen recording; the CTA inside the bottom band; a blurred first frame; disclosure only as a tag; creator hashtags instead of parent search words; "perfect gift" with no price or delivery cost.
lumebook_takeaway: Screen-record the upload, name and dedication steps on the phone, cut to the printed book on a sofa, and end on one spoken and written topic question.
not_verified: Whether the voice is the account owner's; the audio track. The 23 shots are the cut detector's; the first pass lists 11 scene shots. 720 x 1280 is the downloaded copy. The transcript's "בוחרים נוסף" is probably "נושא" (the 0:15 subtitle). The coded cta_type comment_word is a question, with no keyword. The cover and editor show the child's name, not quoted here.
